Kirk: Tariffs Are Taxes on US Businesses and Families
videos.description: Ron Kirk, former US Trade Representative and former Dallas mayor, says tariffs amount to taxes on American businesses and families and warns small businesses and manufacturers will bear the cost of the trade fight. Kirk says the integrated North American economy makes the US, Canada, and Mexico stronger and argues China is the real economic competitor. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Julie Fine on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Dr. Oz: Fraud Findings Could Double Medicare Trust Fund Life
videos.description: Dr. Mehmet Oz, administrator of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, says more than $20 billion identified by the Treasury Department in suspected health care fraud and money laundering could double the life of the Medicare trust fund. Dr. Oz also says more drug pricing deals are in the works and calls on Congress to codify the administration’s most favored nation pricing agreements. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
